text:
Maria Gomez: Heads-up: Roadmap wants a firm plan for APAC pilot capacity and commit/spot policy. Need a decision for Mon review.

Ajay Patel: Vendor updates: A100 lead 9-13w, H100 11-17w. Secondary vendors limited H100 availability.

Kevin Liu: Suggest aligning commits to 95th pct for NA/EU, 80th pct for APAC pilot. Use cloud burst to smooth.

Sasha Bennett: Reliability asks: 2 warm instances per AZ during canary, 6-GPU spillover pool for emergency rollback.

Lenora Ortiz: Finance will run three TCO scenarios (0%, 20%, 40% committed). Need SKU counts by Fri EOD.

Tom Cho: Sales: Both APAC pilots need <120ms p95 at 2k sessions. Can we guarantee with the proposed mix?

Ajay Patel: With committed baseline and spot+burst we can for majority of time, but need hedging rule for spot spikes.

Kevin Liu: Proposal: NA commit 22% (60/40 A100/H100), EU 18% (A100 bias), APAC SG commit 14% + JP 6% for DR/pilot. On-prem hold 45 chassis until contract.

Maria Gomez: Add rollback policy and hedging clause. I'll assemble a short decision memo.

Sasha Bennett: Runbook rule: if p95 > SLO for 5m, autoscale and notify; if >15m, rollback. KV-cache prewarm x1.5.

Lenora Ortiz: Hedging cap request: cap auto-convert budget to 20% of pilot budget. Approval required: Procurement Lead + Finance Director.

Ajay Patel: Procurement action: ask vendors for staged delivery (30/30/40) and penalties for slips >2w.

Kevin Liu: I'll produce per-region SKU table and staged delivery calendar (due Thu).

Tom Cho: Can we offer 60-day ramp support to pilots? Sales needs that to close.

Maria Gomez: Conditional yes; ramp depends on reserves accepted. Also propose OKR: APAC capacity readiness by pilot kickoff.

ops-bot: procurement doc created: https://redwood-internal/procure/1912345678

Finance Bot: Noted. We'll approve after SKU counts. Model will include spot volatility sensitivity.

Ajay Patel: I'll confirm secondary vendor list for APAC by Wed.

Kevin Liu: Owners: Ajay(procurement), Kevin(sizing), Sasha(runbooks), Lenora(finance), Tom(customer ramp), Maria(product). Any blocks?

Sasha Bennett: no blocks from reliability.

Lenora Ortiz: finance will sign off once SKUs provided.

Maria Gomez: OK marking as roadmap candidate for Monday review. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
